title: 29 U.S.C. § 1140 — Interference with Protected Rights (ERISA § 510)
verified_note: USC tool blocked for Title 29; statute text from training knowledge. Verify full text at uscode.house.gov.
case_37_anchor: Identity replacement scheme that places unauthorized 'retired' designation in pension record = §1140 interference with attainment of ongoing accrual rights by 'any person'; reaches non-fiduciary orchestrators
key_cases: Ingersoll-Rand Co. v. McClendon, 498 U.S. 133 (1990) — ERISA preempts state wrongful discharge claim based on pension interference; §1140 is the exclusive federal remedy
Bona v. Barasch, 359 F.3d 587 (2d Cir. 2004) — fraudulent modification of pension records constitutes §1140 interference
